title: Titanium Serrated Lock Washer
alloyReason: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (Grade 5, UNS R56400) was selected for this fastener application because its 900+ MPa tensile enables thin-wall lightweighting under cyclic loading. The alpha-beta microstructure provides 45% higher specific strength than 4140 steel, critical for weight-sensitive designs. Its 6.7 W/mK thermal conductivity simplifies thermal management. This rationale is driven by external tooth serrated lock washer (beta-c) and specific design requirements.
process: CNC turning and boring for fastener geometry
surfaceTreatment: Passivation per ASTM B600 followed by hot DI water rinse 70C minimum to prevent flash rust on finished surfaces — tailored for external tooth serrated application
inspection: Visual VT ASTM E165 (external tooth verified)
commonFailures: Surface contamination requiring acid passivation — critical for external tooth serrated performance

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Serrated Lock Washer suitable for External tooth serrated lock washer (Beta-C)?
faq.a: Titanium Serrated Lock Washer uses Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address fastener operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Serrated Lock Washer?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Serrated Lock Washer is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for external tooth serrated requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Serrated Lock Washer require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. external tooth serrated components require Passivation per ASTM B600 followed by hot DI water rinse 70C minimum to prevent flash rust on finished surfaces — tailored for external tooth serrated application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Serrated Lock Washer shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Serrated Lock Washer includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet external tooth serrated specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.
